name: openrate/openrate
description: Open FX rates from open sources — embedded locally, as a managed sidecar or in-process through the C ABI.

suggest.ext-ffi: For Openrate\Ffi, the in-process C-ABI mode. Needs ffi.enable=1 outside the CLI SAPI; see README.md — the sidecar is the recommended default for PHP.
suggest.ext-pcntl: For examples/fork_probe.php, which demonstrates why the sidecar is the default
